Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Definitions.

Require Import Step.

Require Import Misc.

Reserved Notation "[ L ] G ⊢k S <⦂ U" (at level 70).

Inductive subtykn : vars -> env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=

| snf_vrefl : forall L G x,
    [ L ] G ⊢k typ_sel x <⦂ typ_sel x

| snf_top : forall L G T,
    [ L ] G ⊢k T <⦂ typ_top

| snf_bot : forall L G T,
    [ L ] G ⊢k typ_bot <⦂ T

| snf_bnd : forall L G S T1 T2 U,
    [ L ] G ⊢k S <⦂ T1 ->
    [ L ] G ⊢k T2 <⦂ U ->
    [ L ] G ⊢k typ_bnd T1 T2 <⦂ typ_bnd S U

| snf_all : forall L G T U1 U2 x,
    x `notin` union (fv G)
      (union (fv T) (union (fv U1) (union (fv U2) L))) ->
    [ union L (union (singleton x) (fv T)) ]
      x ~ T ++ G ⊢k open x U1 <⦂ open x U2 ->
    [ L ] G ⊢k typ_all T U1 <⦂ typ_all T U2

| snf_sel1 : forall L G x T S,
    binds x T G ->
    [ L ] G ⊢k T <⦂ typ_bnd S typ_top ->
    [ L ] G ⊢k S <⦂ (typ_sel $ avar_f x)

| snf_sel2 : forall L G x T U,
    binds x T G ->
    [ L ] G ⊢k T <⦂ typ_bnd typ_bot U ->
    [ L ] G ⊢k typ_sel $ avar_f x <⦂ U
where "[ L ] G ⊢k S <⦂ U" := (subtykn L G S U).

Theorem subtykn_equiv_stp_subty : forall L G S U,
    wf_env G ->
    fv S [<=] dom G -> lc S ->
    fv U [<=] dom G -> lc U ->
    [ L ] G ⊢k S <⦂ U <->
    [ L ] G ⊢s S <⦂ U.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Export StdSetup.

Require Export VarDef.

Inductive typ : Set :=
| typ_top : typ
| typ_bot : typ
| typ_sel : avar -> typ
| typ_all : typ -> typ -> typ
| typ_bnd :  typ -> typ -> typ.

Inductive lc_avar_at : nat -> avar -> Prop :=
  | lc_ab : forall {n m}, n < m -> lc_avar_at m (avar_b n)
  | lc_af : forall {n x}, lc_avar_at n (avar_f x).

Global Instance LcAvar : LC avar := { lc_at := lc_avar_at }.

Inductive lc_typ_at : nat -> typ -> Prop :=
  | lc_typ_top : forall {n}, lc_typ_at n typ_top
  | lc_typ_bot : forall {n}, lc_typ_at n typ_bot
  | lc_typ_sel : forall {n v}, lc_at n v -> lc_typ_at n (typ_sel v)
  | lc_typ_all : forall {n T U}, lc_typ_at n T -> lc_typ_at (S n) U ->
                            lc_typ_at n (typ_all T U)
  | lc_typ_bnd : forall {n S U}, lc_typ_at n S -> lc_typ_at n U ->
                            lc_typ_at n (typ_bnd S U).

Global Instance LcTyp : LC typ := { lc_at := lc_typ_at }.

Definition open_rec_avar (k : nat) (u : var) (a : avar) : avar :=
    match a with
    | avar_b i => if k == i then avar_f u else avar_b i
    | avar_f x => avar_f x
    end.

Fixpoint open_rec_typ (k : nat) (u : var) (T : typ) : typ :=
    match T with
    | typ_top => typ_top
    | typ_bot => typ_bot
    | typ_sel x => typ_sel $ open_rec_avar k u x
    | typ_all T U => typ_all (open_rec_typ k u T) $ open_rec_typ (S k) u U
    | typ_bnd T U => typ_bnd (open_rec_typ k u T) $ open_rec_typ k u U
    end.

Global Instance OpenAvar : CanOpen avar := { open_rec := open_rec_avar }.

Global Instance OpenTyp : CanOpen typ := { open_rec := open_rec_typ }.

Notation env := (list (var * typ)).

Definition fv_avar (v : avar) : vars :=
    match v with
    | avar_b _ => {}
    | avar_f x => {{ x }}
    end.

Fixpoint fv_typ (T : typ) : vars :=
    match T with
    | typ_top | typ_bot => {}
    | typ_sel x => fv_avar x
    | typ_all T1 T2 | typ_bnd T1 T2 => fv_typ T1 \u fv_typ T2
    end.

Global Instance FvAvar : HasFv avar := { fv := fv_avar }.

Global Instance FvTyp : HasFv typ := { fv := fv_typ }.

Global Instance FvEnv : HasFv env := { fv := fun e => dom e `union` fv_values fv e }.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Definitions.
Require Import Misc.

Reserved Notation "G ⊢ S ⇑ U" (at level 90).

Inductive exposure : env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=

| exp_stop : forall G T,
    ~is_sel T ->
    G ⊢ T ⇑ T

| exp_top : forall G T,
    G ⊢ T ⇑ typ_top

| exp_bot : forall G1 G2 T x,
    G1 ⊢ T ⇑ typ_bot ->
    G2 ++ x ~ T ++ G1 ⊢ typ_sel (avar_f x) ⇑ typ_bot

| exp_bnd : forall G1 G2 T x L U U',
    G1 ⊢ T ⇑ (typ_bnd L U) ->
    G1 ⊢ U ⇑ U' ->
    G2 ++ x ~ T ++ G1 ⊢ typ_sel (avar_f x) ⇑ U'
where "G ⊢ S ⇑ U" := (exposure G S U).

Reserved Notation "G ⊢ S ↗! U" (at level 90).

Inductive upcast_e : env -> avar -> typ -> Prop :=

| uce_top : forall G x,
    G ⊢ x ↗! typ_top

| uce_bot : forall G1 G2 x T ,
    G1 ⊢ T ⇑ typ_bot ->
    G2 ++ x ~ T ++ G1 ⊢ avar_f x ↗! typ_bot

| uce_bnd : forall G1 G2 x T L U,
    G1 ⊢ T ⇑ typ_bnd L U ->
    G2 ++ x ~ T ++ G1 ⊢ avar_f x ↗! U
where "G ⊢ S ↗! U" := (upcast_e G S U).

Reserved Notation "G ⊢ S ↘! U" (at level 90).

Inductive downcast_e : env -> avar -> typ -> Prop :=

| dce_bot : forall G x,
    G ⊢ x ↘! typ_bot

| dce_top : forall G1 G2 x T,
    G1 ⊢ T ⇑ typ_bot ->
    G2 ++ x ~ T ++ G1 ⊢ avar_f x ↘! typ_top

| dce_bnd : forall G1 G2 x T L U,
    G1 ⊢ T ⇑ (typ_bnd L U) ->
    G2 ++ x ~ T ++ G1 ⊢ avar_f x ↘! L
where "G ⊢ S ↘! U" := (downcast_e G S U).

Reserved Notation "[ L ] G ⊢s S <⦂ U" (at level 70).

Inductive stp_subty : vars -> env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=

| ss_top : forall L G T,
    [ L ] G ⊢s T <⦂ typ_top

| ss_bot : forall L G T,
    [ L ] G ⊢s typ_bot <⦂ T

| ss_sel_refl : forall L G x,
    [ L ] G ⊢s typ_sel x <⦂ typ_sel x

| ss_sel_left : forall L G x T U,
    G ⊢ x ↗! T ->
    [ L ] G ⊢s T <⦂ U ->
    [ L ] G ⊢s typ_sel x <⦂ U

| ss_sel_right : forall L G x T U,
    G ⊢ x ↘! T ->
    [ L ] G ⊢s U <⦂ T ->
    [ L ] G ⊢s U <⦂ typ_sel x

| ss_bnd : forall L G S1 U1 S2 U2,
    [ L ] G ⊢s S2 <⦂ S1 ->
    [ L ] G ⊢s U1 <⦂ U2 ->
    [ L ] G ⊢s typ_bnd S1 U1 <⦂ typ_bnd S2 U2

| ss_all : forall L G T U1 U2 x,
    x `notin` fv G `union` fv T
      `union` fv U1 `union` fv U2 `union` L ->
    [ L  `union` singleton x `union` fv T ]
      x ~ T ++ G ⊢s open x U1 <⦂ open x U2 ->
    [ L ] G ⊢s typ_all T U1 <⦂ typ_all T U2
where "[ L ] G ⊢s S <⦂ U" := (stp_subty L G S U).

(* Basic environment lemmas                                            *)

Lemma dom_in_fv : forall (G : env) (x : atom), x `in` dom G -> x `in` fv G.
Proof. intros. simpl. fsetdec. Qed.

Lemma notin_fv_dom : forall (G : env) (x : atom), x `notin` fv G -> x `notin` dom G.
Proof. intros x G H. simpl in H. fsetdec. Qed.

Lemma wf_env_uniq : forall G, wf_env G -> uniq G.
Proof.
  intros G H. induction H.
  - apply uniq_nil.
  - apply uniq_push.
    + assumption.
    + apply notin_fv_dom. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma binds_in_dom : forall (x : atom) (a : typ) (E : env), binds x a E -> x `in` dom E.
Proof.
  intros x a E H. induction E as [| [y c] E'].
  - inversion H.
  - simpl. simpl in H. destruct H as [Heq | Hin].
    + inversion Heq; subst; fsetdec.
    + apply IHE' in Hin; fsetdec.
Qed.

Lemma binds_decomp : forall (x : atom) (a : typ) (G : env),
    binds x a G -> exists G1 G2, G = G2 ++ (x,a) :: G1.
Proof.
  intros x a G H. induction G as [| [y c] G'].
  - inversion H.
  - simpl in H. destruct H as [Heq | Hin].
    + inversion Heq; subst. exists G', nil. reflexivity.
    + destruct (IHG' Hin) as [G1 [G2 Heq2]]. exists G1, ((y,c)::G2). simpl. rewrite Heq2. reflexivity.

Lemma uniq_head_notin : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (a : typ), uniq ((x,a)::E) -> x `notin` dom E.
Proof. intros. inversion H. assumption. Qed.

  uniq (G2 ++ (x,a) :: G1) ->

    + simpl in Heq.

      assert (Hyx : y = x) by (apply (f_equal (@fst atom typ)) in Hpair; simpl in Hpair; exact Hpair).

Lemma binds_func : forall (G : env) (x : atom) (a b : typ),
    uniq G -> binds x a G -> binds x b G -> a = b.
Proof.
  intros G. induction G as [| [y c] G']; intros x a b Hu Ha Hb.
  - inversion Ha.
  - simpl in Ha, Hb.
    destruct Ha as [Ha | Ha]; destruct Hb as [Hb | Hb].
    + inversion Ha. inversion Hb. subst. reflexivity.
    + inversion Ha. subst. exfalso.
      assert (Hnot : y `notin` dom G') by (inversion Hu; assumption).

    + inversion Hb. subst. exfalso.
      assert (Hnot : y `notin` dom G') by (inversion Hu; assumption).
      apply binds_in_dom in Ha. fsetdec.

Lemma wf_env_tail : forall (G2 G1 : env) (x : atom) (a : typ),
    wf_env (G2 ++ (x,a) :: G1) -> wf_env G1.
Proof.

  - simpl in H. inversion H. assumption.
  - simpl in H. apply IHG2'' with (x:=x) (a:=a). inversion H. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_binds_lc : forall (G : env) (x : atom) (a : typ),
    wf_env G -> binds x a G -> lc a.
Proof.
  intros G. induction G as [| [y c] G']; intros x a Hwf Hb.
  - inversion Hb.
  - simpl in Hb. inversion Hwf; subst. destruct Hb as [Heq | Hin].
    + inversion Heq. subst. assumption.
    + eapply IHG'; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma wf_binds_fv : forall (G : env) (x : atom) (a : typ),
    wf_env G -> binds x a G -> fv a [<=] dom G.
Proof.
  intros G. induction G as [| [y c] G']; intros x a Hwf Hb.
  - inversion Hb.
  - simpl in Hb. inversion Hwf; subst. destruct Hb as [Heq | Hin].
    + inversion Heq. subst. simpl. fsetdec.
    + eapply le_trans; [eapply IHG'; eauto | simpl; fsetdec].
Qed.

Lemma wf_decomp_fv : forall (G2 G1 : env) (x : atom) (a : typ),
    wf_env (G2 ++ (x,a) :: G1) -> fv a [<=] dom G1.
Proof.

  - simpl in H. inversion H. assumption.
  - simpl in H. inversion H. eapply IHG2''. eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_decomp_lc : forall (G2 G1 : env) (x : atom) (a : typ),
    wf_env (G2 ++ (x,a) :: G1) -> lc a.
Proof.
  intros. apply (@wf_binds_lc (G2 ++ (x,a) :: G1) x a); auto.

Qed.

- top-source absorption (`S = top → ∀z, sel z <: U`);

**Kernel → step (`kn_to_ss`)** — induction on the kernel derivation. - the main translation to kernel subtyping under `wf_env`, `lc`, and `fv ⊆ dom` hypotheses;
- top-source absorption (`S = top → ∀z, sel z <: U`);
- bottom-target absorption (`U = bot → ∀z, S <: sel z`);
- the impossibility `S = top → U = bot → False`.

The select cases build `snf_sel1`/`snf_sel2` from exposure facts, while impossible cases (e.g. a `dce_bot` upcast/bottom combination) are discharged by the auxiliary conjuncts, which give the induction hypothesis enough information without needing the discarded subderivation.

**Kernel → step (`kn_to_ss`)** — induction on the kernel derivation. The two select rules are handled by exposing the environment type: two recursions over the step derivation (`ss_bound_cov`, `ss_bound_ctr`, implemented as `fix` so recursive premises remain available) show that a step derivation into `bnd bot U` / `bnd S top` yields a `bot` or `bnd Lo Wo` exposure with the required `Wo <: U` / `S <: Lo` relation. The exposure is restricted to the tail context with `exp_restrict`, then turned into the matching upcast/downcast and combined with `ss_sel_left`/`ss_sel_right`.

Supporting infrastructure includes environment decomposition/uniqueness lemmas, local-closure and free-variable lemmas for `open`, exposure preservation/restriction, and exposure-to-kernel translations (`exp_subst`, `exp_ctr`, `exp_bot_kn`, `exp_bot_ctr`).
